mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
select u.id as id, u.name as name, u.account as account, u.create_time as createTime, u.enable as enable from sys_user u order by u.id desc
